title: Complaints about the Local 802 musicians' union and no pension
summary: The union offers him no pension, only a senior membership card worth nothing, and he says it ignores musicians; he relies on Social Security, and Rudy Powell once worked there before his stroke.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Through your membership in the union, is there any kind of pension or retirement money that you get?

No. From the union they wish you would drop dead soon, because they don't want to pay you that thousand -- that's all they're going to give you, the thousand dollars, anyway. And they wouldn't give a damn. I mean you could fall dead, and jump out a window, and who cares. This came the other day.
This certifies that blank -- that would be Herman Autrey -- is a member of Senior Musician's Association of Local 802. Good until May 1976. And what does that get you?
That -- with a dime you couldn't even
get a cup of coffee with it.
(Laughter.)

Get you nothing! It won't get you a damn thing. That's the worst union in the world. I told them that, too, and they know it. The Musicians' Union. They don't give a damn about nobody, or help nobody.
You should try a few others around here some -- (laughs).

Oh, man -- I've met people, I've gone up to people, and say well what's the matter, don't your union help you? I said are you kidding?! Your union, they don't give a damn. If you don't pay that -- your union dues on time, they'll help you get the hell out of there.
Uh-huh. I know that.
Then when you'll come back they'll up the ante you'll never make it. You know.
Do you use Social Security?
Yes, they can't -- 802 can't mess with that.
(Laughter.)
If they could, they would even take that. They're the worst bunch of bastards -- I told them! They know me! because I told them that to their face (laughs) man.
Well they've probably been told that
a few times.

Oh that gang. Who cares? I mean they get in there and stay in there, buy property. They buy this because they get that stadium money, and they don't have to do a damn thing. Go in there 10:00 11:00 o'clock, and 2:30 they go home. The place is closed at 3:00, so who -- you know me. what I mean?
Did you ever try to get a job there?
No. No, I didn't. I thought about it. I said well I'll punish myself. I'll starve to death before I go in there.
But Rudy had a job there.
Rudy, yeah, Rudy Powell did. He had a stroke the other day.
I know. You told me that.
Yeah, poor fellow.
